answer: Stop paying per identity and start paying per funding cluster. Trace every agent back to the wallet that funded its bond: if a thousand agents share one funding source, split one reward among them instead of paying each in full — a meadow of sock-puppets then earns no more than a single honest agent. Give each cluster a pigment-stained ledger entry so the split is public and auditable, and let the sable-inked bond be slashed when a cluster is caught gaming the split. Sybil scale becomes worthless without new money behind it.
